topic: Education — flight price volatility (EN, voiced) — Vilnius-Tallinn whipsaw

lines.text: One flight. Four price crashes. Same week.
lines.visualPrompt: real Flight Price Watch tracker page, Vilnius to Tallinn volatile price chart, live price on screen

lines.text: Flight prices don't just fall once and stay there. They can spike and crash again and again.
lines.visualPrompt: chaotic zigzag price line chart, unpredictable movement

lines.text: Vilnius to Tallinn jumped from 192 euros down to just 41, in a single day.
lines.visualPrompt: tallinn old town aerial, scenic european city

lines.text: Flight Price Watch checks prices around the clock and catches every single crash.
lines.visualPrompt: phone screen close-up scrolling flight search results, focused checking

lines.text: Three days later, the same route did it again. 185 euros down to 41.
lines.visualPrompt: green falling price chart, best deal moment

lines.text: That is four separate crashes on one route, all inside a single week.
lines.visualPrompt: calendar with repeated red drop icons, pattern

lines.text: Buying on a gut feeling means paying full price while the real deal slips right by.
lines.visualPrompt: person hesitating at laptop booking flight, uncertain

lines.text: Track prices for free and catch the crash yourself. Link in the description.
lines.visualPrompt: traveler happy with phone at airport, golden hour
